DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内板をご覧ですね。今日は広い範囲を回られるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tinitingnan ang information board. Malawak ba ang iikutan ngayon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 運動不足なので少し歩きたいですが、二十分以内で入口へ戻れる道を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 運動不足なので少し歩きたいと伝え、二十分以内で入口へ戻る道を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Kulang ako sa ehersisyo kaya gusto kong maglakad nang kaunti, pero rutang babalik sa pasukan sa loob ng dalawampung minuto ang hanap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing kulang sa ehersisyo at nais kaunting lakad, at humingi ng balik sa pasukan sa loob ng dalawampung minuto. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この図の池を回る道は、ゆっくり歩くと三十分ほどです。花壇まで行って戻るなら十五分ほどですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Mga tatlumpung minuto ang ikot sa lawa kung mabagal. Mga labinlima kung flowerbed at pabalik.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら花壇で折り返します。さっき雨が降りましたが、途中に滑りやすい坂はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十五分の花壇往復を選び、雨の後に滑りやすい坂がないか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sa flowerbed na ako babalik. Umulan kanina; may madulas bang dalisdis sa daan?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Piliin ang labinlimang minutong flowerbed balikan at itanong ang madulas na dalisdis matapos ulan. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 花壇までの舗装路は平らです。ただ、木の下はぬれています。芝生へ入る近道は避けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Patag ang sementadong daan pero basa sa ilalim ng puno. Iwasan ang shortcut sa damuhan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 芝生の近道は使いません。花壇に着く前に休みたくなったら、どこに座れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 芝生の近道を避けると伝え、花壇より手前で座れる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ako sa damuhan. Kung gusto kong magpahinga bago flowerbed, saan uupo?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing iiwas sa shortcut na damuhan at itanong ang upuan bago flowerbed. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 途中の分かれ道の手前に屋根付きのベンチがあります。右へ曲がると別の出口なので、花壇へは左です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: May may-bubong na bangko bago sangandaan. Ibang labasan sa kanan, kaya kaliwa sa flowerbed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かれ道は左ですね。帰りに別の出口へ出ないよう、同じ道を引き返す目印も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 往路の分岐は左と確認し、別の出口へ出ないため復路の目印を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Kaliwa sa sangandaan. Gusto ko rin ang palatandaan pabalik sa parehong daan para hindi sa ibang labasan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyaking kaliwa sa papunta at itanong ang palatandaang pauwi para iwas ibang labasan. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻る時は、青い案内板が見えた所を右です。今いる入口は白い門なので、二つを覚えておくとよいですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sa balik, kanan kapag nakita ang asul na board. Puting gate ang pasukan ngayon; tandaan ang dalawa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 帰りは青い案内板で右へ曲がって白い門へ戻ります。疲れたら花壇まで行かず、屋根付きのベンチで折り返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 青い案内板で右、白い門へ戻る経路を復唱し、疲れたら手前のベンチで折り返すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Kanan sa asul na board pabalik sa puting gate. Kung pagod, sa may-bubong na bangko bago flowerbed ako babalik.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ulitin ang kanan sa asul na board at puting gate, at magpasyang bumalik sa naunang bangko kung pagod. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ええ、歩く距離は途中で調整してください。足元に気をつけて、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Oo, baguhin ang layo sa daan ayon sa kaya. Ingat sa tapak, magandang lakad.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの便をお探しですか。こちらの案内板は、この乗り場から出るバスのものです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Aling biyahe ang hanap? Para sa bus mula sa hintuang ito ang board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が送ってくれた乗換案内には「中央広場」とあります。同じ名前が二つあるのですが、どちらで降りればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 中央広場という同名の停留所のどちらで降りるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Central Plaza ang nasa transfer directions ng kaibigan. Dalawang kapangalan, saan bababa?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong alin sa dalawang Central Plaza na hintuan ang bababaan. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 停留所名だけでなく、進行方向も見ましょう。その案内には何方面と書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Direksiyon din, hindi pangalan lang. Anong direksiyon sa gabay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「展示館方面」です。私は反対の「車庫方面」の欄を見ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 展示館方面が目的で反対の車庫方面を見ていたと気づいて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Exhibition Hall. Kabaligtarang Depot column pala ang tinitingnan ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing Exhibition Hall ang pakay pero napansing Depot na kabaligtaran ang tiningnan. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 展示館方面なら、こちらの欄です。中央広場で乗り換える次の便はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ito ang column sa Exhibition Hall. Alam ang susunod na bus sa Central Plaza?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 次は五番のバスです。中央広場で降りた場所から、そのまま五番に乗れるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 次は五番と示して降車場所と乗換乗り場が同じか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Numero lima. Mula sa binabaan, roon din ba sasakay sa lima?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing lima ang susunod at tiyaking pareho ang babaan at sakayan ng transfer. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この乗換図では、降車場所から横断歩道を渡った側に五番の乗り場があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sa mapang ito, nasa kabila ng tawiran mula babaan ang numero lima.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 横断歩道を渡る時間も必要なのですね。乗換時間が三分しかない案内なので、次の便に変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 横断時間を考慮して三分の乗換を避け次の便に変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Kailangan din ang pagtawid. Tatlong minuto lang ang transfer, kaya sa susunod na biyahe sana.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Isama ang oras ng pagtawid at piliin ang susunod sa halip na tatlong minutong transfer. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 急いで渡らず、余裕を取ったほうがよいですね。こちらに次の五番の便を含めた案内を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Mas mabuting may oras kaysa magmadaling tumawid. Ibibigay ang gabay na kasama ang susunod na lima.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 次の便を使う案内をもらいます。降りる前に展示館方面の中央広場か、車内の表示でも確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 余裕のある案内を受け取り降車前に方向と停留所名も確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Kukunin ang gabay sa susunod. Bago bumaba, titingnan sa display sa bus kung Central Plaza papuntang Exhibition Hall.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tanggapin ang maluwag na gabay at sabihing susuriin ang direksiyon at pangalan bago bumaba. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 乗換図と新しい案内はこちらです。横断時もお気をつけて、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ito ang mapa at bagong gabay. Ingat sa pagtawid at biyahe.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申請する証明書は、ご本人の分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Para sa inyo ba ang certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 妹の分を頼まれて来ました。この用紙の申請者欄には、妹の名前を書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 妹の代理で来たと説明し申請者欄の記入を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Para sa nakababatang kapatid kong babae. Pangalan niya ba sa applicant field?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na para sa nakababatang kapatid na babae at itanong ang applicant field. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご家族でも、ご本人が来られた場合とは確認の仕方が違います。妹さんから預かった書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kahit pamilya, iba ang pagtiyak sa may-aring pumunta. May ipinadalang dokumento?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 用件を書いたメモだけです。妹が自分で書いた申請書だと思っていましたが、白紙の用紙でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 預かったのはメモと白紙の用紙だけだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Tala lang ng pakay. Akala ko sinulatan niyang application, pero blangko pala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing tala at blangkong form lang ang ipinagkatiwala. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: このまま妹さんの代わりに署名することはせず、代理の方の申請案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Huwag basta pumirma para sa kanya; tingnan ang representative application guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 妹の名前を勝手に署名しないようにします。代理申請の案内は紙でもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 妹の代筆署名をせず代理申請の紙の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko pipirmahan ang pangalan niya nang basta. Maaari bang papel na proxy guide?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag pumirma para sa kapatid at humingi ng papel na proxy guide. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらをお渡しします。必要な書類は証明書の種類や請求の事情も確認してご案内します。証明書名はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ito. Nakasalalay ang dokumento sa certificate at kalagayan. Alam ang pangalan ng certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 妹のメモには種類が書かれていません。提出先の案内を妹から送ってもらってから、必要書類を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 証明書の種類が不明なため妹から提出先の指定を送ってもらうと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Walang uri sa tala niya. Ipapasend ko ang tagubilin ng pagsusumite mula sa kapatid bago magtanong sa dokumento.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi alam ang certificate kaya ipapasend sa kapatid ang hinihingi ng pagsusumitan. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、本日は申請を進めず、案内を受け取るところまでにしましょう。お預かりしたメモはお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Huwag munang aplikasyon ngayon, gabay lang. Ibabalik ang tala.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メモと白紙の用紙を持ち帰ります。妹に提出先の指定と代理申請の案内を見てもらい、準備してから来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メモと用紙を持ち帰り妹と案内を確認して準備後に再訪すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Iuuwi ang tala at blangkong form. Ipapatingin sa kapatid ang hinihingi at proxy guide, saka babalik na handa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasyang iuwi ang tala at form, tingnan ang gabay kasama kapatid, at bumalik matapos maghanda. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 書類がそろうか不明な点は、来庁前にもお問い合わせください。本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Kung hindi sigurado ang kumpletong dokumento, magtanong bago pumunta rin. Salamat ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票のこの二つの欄で迷われていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Nalilito ba sa dalawang field na ito?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「食欲」と「吐き気」の違いがわかりません。どちらも食べられないことですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 食欲と吐き気の意味の違いを質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Hindi alam ang kaibahan ng gana at pagduduwal. Parehong hindi makakain?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang pagkakaiba ng gana at pagduduwal. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食欲は食べたい気持ちで、吐き気は吐きそうな感じです。今はどのような状態ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Gana ang pagnanais kumain; pagduduwal ang pakiramdam na susuka. Ano ngayon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 吐きそうではありませんが、食べたい気持ちがなく、昨日の夕食は半分残しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 吐き気はなく食欲が落ちて夕食を半分残したと区別して説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi nasusuka pero walang ganang kumain, kalahati ng hapunan kahapon ang natira.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang walang pagduduwal at mababang gana, at sabihing kalahati ng hapunan natira. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その違いがわかるように書きましょう。今日は食事や水分を取れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Isulat para malinaw. Nakakain at nakainom ngayon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 朝はパンを一口だけ食べ、水はコップ一杯飲みました。量も問診票に書いたほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 朝に食べたパンと水の量を示し記入が必要か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Isang kagat ng tinapay at isang basong tubig sa umaga. Isusulat din ang dami?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang dami ng tinapay at tubig at itanong kung isusulat. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、食べた量と飲んだ量を分けて書いてください。診察でも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Oo, magkahiwalay ang kinain at ininom. Susuriin din sa konsultasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 「朝食はパン一口、水一杯」と書きます。原因が胃の病気なのか、ここで教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 飲食量の書き方を示し胃の病気か受付段階で判断できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Isusulat almusal isang kagat, tubig isang baso. Dito ba masasabi kung sakit ng sikmura ang sanhi?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang pagsulat ng dami at itanong kung masasabi sa reception ang sakit sa sikmura. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この段階では原因を判断できません。診察で医師にお尋ねください。記入のお手伝いならできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Hindi pa mahuhusgahan ang sanhi. Itanong sa doktor sa pagsusuri. Makakatulong ako sa form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 病名を自分で書かず、食欲がないことと飲食した量を記入して診察で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 病名を推測せず食欲低下と飲食量を診察で伝えると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hindi ako magsusulat ng sakit sa hula; ilalagay ang walang gana at dami, ipapaliwanag sa doktor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Huwag hulaan ang sakit at magpasyang sabihin ang mababang gana at dami sa doktor. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記入できたらこちらへお出しください。待つ間につらさが増したらお知らせくださいね。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ibigay dito kapag tapos. Sabihin kung lumala habang naghihintay. Magpagaling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の内容を伺います。今、誰かに追いかけられたり、直接会うよう迫られたりしていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Pakisabi ang pakay. May humahabol o namimilit na makipagkita nang direkta ngayon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: そのようなことはありません。ただ、配達の連絡だと思った画面に住所を入れてしまい、不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 直接の危険はないが配達案内の画面に住所を入力したと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Walang ganoon. Pero inilagay ko ang address sa screen na akala ko delivery notice, kaya nag-aalala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing walang direktang panganib ngunit naglagay ng address sa delivery screen. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつ、どのように画面を開きましたか。覚えている範囲でお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kailan at paano binuksan? Sabihin ayon sa naaalala.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝九時ごろ、携帯に届いた短いメッセージのリンクを開きました。荷物の再配達だと書かれていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今朝九時ごろ短いメッセージのリンクを開いた経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mga alas-nuwebe ngayong umaga, link sa maikling message sa phone. Redelivery ang nakasulat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang pagbukas ng short-message link mga alas-nuwebe ngayon. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入力したのは住所だけですか。カード番号や暗証番号なども入力しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Address lang? May card number o PIN din?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前と住所と電話番号です。カード番号は求められましたが、その前に画面を閉じました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 氏名住所電話番号は入力したがカード情報は入れず閉じたと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pangalan, address at phone. Hiningi ang card pero isinara bago iyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Linawing pangalan-address-phone ang nilagay pero walang card bago isinara. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容を整理して確認します。元のメッセージは残っていますか。もう一度リンクを開く必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ayusin natin ang impormasyon. May orihinal na message? Hindi kailangang buksan ulit ang link.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 元のメッセージはあります。画面を開き直さず、届いた時刻と入力した情報をメモして見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元のメッセージを残しリンクを再度開かず時刻と入力情報をメモで示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Mayroon. Hindi bubuksan ulit, itatala ang oras ng dating at impormasyong nilagay at ipapakita.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itabi ang message, huwag ulitin ang link, at ipakita ang tala ng oras at input. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。相談として伺いますが、これだけで犯罪の有無や被害が出ないことを断定はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Salamat. Konsultasyon ito, pero hindi pa masasabing may krimen o walang pinsala mula rito lang.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 被害がないと決まったわけではないのですね。同じ相手から電話が来た場合の対応も、担当の方に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 被害の有無は未確定と理解し追加の電話への対応も担当者に相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hindi pa pala tiyak na walang pinsala. Gusto ko ring itanong sa namamahala kung tumawag ang parehong tao.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Unawaing hindi tiyak ang pinsala at nais konsultahin ang dagdag na tawag. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 入力内容のメモをお持ちのまま、こちらで担当者をお待ちください。続けて詳しい状況を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Hawakan ang input note at maghintay sa namamahala rito. Itutuloy ang detalye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 持ち上げた際に底がたわんでいますね。箱の中は重い物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Lumalaylay ang ilalim kapag inangat. Mabigat ba ang laman?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 辞書と本を家族に送ります。前に使った箱なので、このまま預けてよいか見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本を入れた再利用の箱をこのまま預けられるか状態確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Diksiyonaryo at libro para sa pamilya. Gamit nang kahon, pakisuri kung maipapadala nang ganito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipasuri ang reused box ng libro kung tatanggapin nang ganoon. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 底の一部がはがれているので、今の状態ではお預かりできません。別の箱に詰め直せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: May natatanggal sa ilalim kaya hindi matatanggap ngayon. Makakapaglipat sa ibang kahon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家に小さな箱が二つあります。本を半分ずつ入れて、二個口で送ることもできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小箱二つに本を分けて二個で送れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Dalawang maliit sa bahay. Puwedeng kalahati sa bawat isa at dalawang pakete?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itanong ang paghahati ng libro sa dalawang maliit na kahon at dalawang padala. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それぞれの箱で大きさと重さを確認し、別々に受け付ける方法があります。送料も箱ごとにかかります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Maaari ang sukat at bigat ng bawat kahon, hiwalay na pagtanggap. May shipping sa bawat isa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 箱ごとに送料がかかるのですね。大きな箱を一つ買う場合と、どちらが安いか今わかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箱ごとに送料がかかると理解し大箱一つとの費用比較を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Bawat isa pala ang shipping. Alam ba ngayon kung mas mura kaysa bumili ng isang malaki?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Unawain ang bawat-kahong shipping at humingi ng paghahambing sa isang malaki. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 詰めた後の寸法と重さが必要なので、今は正確に比べられません。販売している箱の価格表はお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kailangan ang sukat-bigat matapos ikahon, kaya hindi tiyak ngayon. Maibibigay ang box price list.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 価格表をください。家で二つに分けた重さも量ってから決めます。隙間は新聞紙で埋めてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱の価格表を求め自宅で計量することと隙間の梱包材を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pahingi. Titimbangin ang dalawang hati sa bahay bago pumili. Puwedeng diyaryo ang puwang?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Humingi ng box price list, magsabi ng pagtimbang sa bahay, at magtanong sa packing ng puwang. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新聞紙で隙間を埋める方法もあります。本が動かないように包み、箱の底も丈夫な状態にしてください。梱包材の案内もこちらにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Puwede ang diyaryo. Balutin para hindi gumalaw at tiyaking matibay ang ilalim. May gabay sa materyal dito rin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は箱を持ち帰って詰め直します。二箱の寸法と重さを控えて、送料を確認してから発送します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本日は持ち帰り詰め直して寸法と重さを準備し送料確認後に発送すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Iuuwi at ililipat ngayon. Itatala ang sukat-bigat ng dalawa, saka shipping check bago ipadala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing iuuwi at ire-repack, ihahanda ang sukat-bigat, at ipapadala matapos shipping check. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 荷物はまだ受け付けていませんので、そのままお持ち帰りください。案内二枚もお忘れなく。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Hindi pa tinanggap kaya iuwi. Huwag kalimutan ang dalawang gabay. Ingat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込の操作についてのご相談ですね。どの段階で止まりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol sa transfer operation. Saan huminto?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 送金を確定した直後に通信が切れました。完了画面が出なかったので、もう一度送ろうか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 確定直後の通信切断で完了が不明なため再送金すべきか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Naputol ang koneksiyon pagkakumpirma. Walang complete screen kaya hindi alam kung uulitin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Kumonsulta kung uulitin dahil putol matapos kumpirma at hindi tiyak ang tapos. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 重複する可能性があるので、確認するまで同じ振込を繰り返さないでください。受付番号の記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Baka madoble, huwag ulitin hanggang masuri. May reference number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 画面は保存できませんでしたが、受付番号の入った通知が一通届いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面保存はないが受付番号付きの通知があると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi nasave ang screen pero may isang notification na may reference number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing walang save pero may notification na may reference number. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その番号で状況を調べます。振込の金額と操作した時刻をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Susuriin sa numerong iyon. Magkano at kailan ginawa?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 金額は三万二千円で、十分ほど前です。請求書も持ってきたので照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三万二千円と十分前の操作を伝え請求書の照合を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Tatlumpu't dalawang libong yen, mga sampung minuto. Dala ang invoice, pakitugma.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang tatlumpu't dalawang libong yen at sampung minuto at ipatugma ang invoice. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 番号と内容を担当に照会します。すぐに結果が出ない場合もあるため、お待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Itatanong ang numero at detalye. Baka hindi agad ang resulta, makapaghihintay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待ちます。相手に今すぐもう一度払うよう言われても、確認結果が出るまで追加で振り込まないほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 照会を待つと伝え相手に催促されても追加送金を控えるべきか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Maghihintay. Kahit piliting magbayad ulit ngayon, iwas muna sa dagdag hanggang resulta, tama?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing hihintayin ang inquiry at tiyaking iwas sa dagdag kahit pinipilit ng tatanggap. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、重複を避けるため状況を確認しましょう。こちらでは現時点で着金まで断定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Oo, tingnan para hindi doble. Hindi pa namin matitiyak ang pagpasok ng pera ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 相手には銀行で照会中だと連絡します。通知を消さず、結果を聞いてから次の操作を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相手には照会中と連絡し通知を残して結果後に次の操作を判断すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sasabihin kong sinusuri ng bangko. Hindi buburahin ang notification, saka magpapasya ng susunod matapos resulta.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasyang sabihin ang inquiry, itabi ang notification, at susunod na operasyon matapos resulta. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受付番号を確認しますので、この窓口でお待ちください。通知の画面はそのまま保管をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Tiyakin ang reference, maghintay sa counter. Itabi ang screen nang ganoon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計は千九百円です。こちらの割引券をお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Isang libo siyam na raan ang bill. Gagamitin ang coupon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 使いたいです。百円引きと書いてありますが、この買い物で使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 百円割引券を千九百円の買い物に使えるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Gusto ko. Isang daang yen off, puwede sa binili?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang one-hundred-yen coupon sa one-thousand-nine-hundred-yen na bili. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 下の条件では、商品代金が二千円以上の場合に使える券です。今回は百円足りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Dalawang libo pataas ang produkto ayon sa kondisyon. Kulang ng isang daan ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、あそこの二百円のお菓子を足せば使えますね。追加すると支払いはいくらになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二百円のお菓子を追加した場合の割引後の支払額を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kung dagdag ng dalawang daang snack, puwede. Magkano ang bayad pagkatapos?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itanong ang discounted total kapag dagdag na two-hundred-yen snack. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品代金が二千百円になり、券で百円引くと二千円です。袋が必要なら別に五円かかります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Dalawang libo isang daan ang produkto, bawas isang daan ay dalawang libo. Bag dagdag limang yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今のまま買うより百円多くなりますね。お菓子は必要ないので追加せず、券は次に使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不要な買い足しで百円支払いが増えるため追加せず券を次回に回すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Isang daan pang mas mataas kaysa ngayon. Hindi kailangan ang snack, hindi magdadagdag at coupon sa susunod.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag idagdag ang hindi kailangan na nagpapataas ng isang daan at itabi ang coupon sa susunod. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 追加なしで千九百円ですね。袋はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Walang dagdag, isang libo siyam na raan. May bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一つ持っていますが、入り切らないので五円の袋を一枚ください。重い缶詰は自分の袋に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持参袋に缶詰を入れ不足分として五円の袋を一枚買う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: May isa pero kulang, isang limang yen na bag. Mabigat na de-lata sa sariling bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ilagay ang de-lata sa sariling bag at bumili ng isang five-yen bag sa sobra. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 袋一枚を加えて千九百五円です。支払いは現金でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kasama ang bag, isang libo siyam na raan at lima. Cash?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 現金で千九百五円ちょうど払います。割引券も返してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 千九百五円を現金でちょうど払い割引券の返却を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Eksaktong isang libo siyam na raan at lima, cash. Pakibalik din ang coupon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Bayaran ang eksaktong one-thousand-nine-hundred-five-yen cash at ipabalik ang coupon. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ちょうどお預かりしました。券とレシートをお返しします。お買い上げありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Eksakto ang natanggap. Coupon at resibo ito. Salamat sa pagbili.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遊具へ向かう道はこちらですが、今日は広場で練習の音が聞こえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Dito ang daan sa palaruan pero may ingay ng ensayo sa plaza ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもがベビーカーで寝ているので、静かな場所を少し歩きたいです。広場を通らない道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 眠る子どものため広場の音を避ける散歩道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Tulog ang bata sa stroller kaya tahimik na maikling lakad sana. May hindi dadaan sa plaza?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang lakarang iwas ingay sa plaza para sa natutulog na bata. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 花の通路なら広場から離れています。入口に段差がありますが、横のスロープをご利用いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Malayo sa plaza ang flower walkway. May baitang sa pasukan pero may ramp sa tabi.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: スロープを使います。案内図の細い道から入ると近そうですが、ベビーカーでも通れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: スロープを選び近道をベビーカーで通れるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ramp ako. Mukhang shortcut ang maliit sa mapa, puwede sa stroller?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Piliin ang ramp at tiyakin kung shortcut ay kaya ng stroller. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その近道には狭い車止めがあります。無理に通さず、こちらの広い入口からお入りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: May makitid na vehicle barrier doon. Huwag ipilit, sa malapad na pasukan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 車止めの隙間を通すのはやめます。ベビーカーを畳まずに行ける広い入口から回ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 狭い車止めを避けベビーカーを畳まず広い入口から入ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi isisingit sa barrier. Iikot sa malapad na pasukan nang hindi tinitiklop ang stroller.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Iwas sa makitid na barrier at sa malapad nang hindi tinitiklop ang stroller. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 花の通路の先には休憩所があります。ただ、今日は清掃中で中には入れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: May pahingahan sa dulo pero nililinis ngayon, bawal pumasok.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 休憩所が使えないなら、そこで引き返します。外で腰を下ろせるベンチは途中にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 清掃中の休憩所では引き返し途中の屋外ベンチを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Kung hindi magamit, roon babalik. May outdoor bench sa daan?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Bumalik sa nililinis na pahingahan at itanong ang outdoor bench sa daan. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通路の右側にベンチがあります。ベビーカーは通行の妨げにならない脇の空間へ寄せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: May bench sa kanan. Itabi ang stroller sa puwang para hindi hadlang.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ベンチではベビーカーを脇へ寄せて休み、帰りも車止めを避けて広い入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ベビーカーを脇へ寄せて休み帰りも広い入口を使うと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Itatabi sa bench at magpapahinga, at uwi iwas barrier patungong malapad din.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyaking itatabi ang stroller sa pahinga at malapad na pasukan din sa uwi. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 清掃中の場所には入らず、どうぞゆっくりお過ごしください。お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Huwag sa nililinis at magpahinga nang maayos. Ingat pauwi.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お待ちのバスについてですか。現在、到着が遅れている便があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Sa bus na hinihintay? May nahuhuling dumating ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人を迎えに行く約束があるのですが、十時発のバスはもう出ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人を迎えに行く予定があると説明し、十時発のバスが出発済みか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: May sundo akong kaibigan. Umalis na ba ang alas-diyes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing may sundong kaibigan at itanong kung umalis na ang ten-o'clock bus. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その便はまだ来ていません。到着見込みも出ていないため、何分遅れるとはお伝えできない状況です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi pa dumating. Wala pang tantiya kaya hindi masabi ilang minuto.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ来ていないのですね。友人には十時半に会うと言ってしまいました。別の便なら間に合いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予定のバスが未到着だと確認し、十時半の待合せに別の便なら間に合うか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Wala pa pala. Nasabi kong alas-diyes y medya ang kita. Iba bang bus aabot?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tiyaking hindi pa dumating ang bus at itanong kung ibang biyahe aabot sa ten-thirty. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の便も同じ道路の混雑を受けています。今の情報だけで十時半に着ける便はご案内できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Pareho ang trapiko ng ibang bus. Hindi makapagbibigay ng aabot alas-diyes y medya mula sa impormasyon ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら、友人には待ち合わせ場所から動かずに待ってもらって、私が乗れた時点で連絡します。ここで電話しても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人には場所を動かず待ってもらい乗車後に連絡すると決め、ここで電話してよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Papahintayin ko ang kaibigan nang hindi lilipat ng lugar, tatawag pagkasakay. Puwede bang dito tumawag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Magpasyang ipahintay sa parehong lugar at tumawag pagkasakay, at itanong ang tawag rito. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路を空けて、窓際の待合席でお願いします。放送が入るので、電話中も乗り場の表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Luwagan ang daanan at sa window waiting seats. May anunsiyo kaya tingnan ang bay display kahit nasa tawag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 窓際へ移ります。バスが着いたら表示は『到着』に変わりますか。それとも放送だけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 窓際に移ると答え、バス到着時は表示が変わるのか放送だけか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Lilipat sa bintana. Kapag dumating, mag-iiba sa arrived ang display o anunsiyo lang?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing lilipat sa bintana at itanong kung display o anunsiyo lang kapag dating. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 係員が到着を確認してから、乗り場番号を表示し、放送もします。表示が出る前に道路側で待つ必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Pagkatiyak ng kawani, ilalabas ang bay number at anunsiyo. Hindi kailangang sa gilid ng kalsada bago display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。表示が出るまでは席で待ち、友人には今のうちに予定変更を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示が出るまで席で待ち、友人に予定変更を伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige, upo hanggang display, at sasabihin ko na ngayon ang bagong plano.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing upo hanggang display at sasabihin sa kaibigan ang pagbabago. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、乗り場が決まりましたらご案内します。電話のあとも待合席でお待ちください。どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-47212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Oo, gagabayan kapag may bay na. Pagkatapos tumawag, sa upuan pa rin. Ingat.
